# Ying Wen

> Ying Wen (温颖) is a Tenure-Track Associate Professor at Shanghai Jiao Tong University, School of Artificial Intelligence, and a mentor at Shanghai Innovation Institute. His research focuses on reinforcement learning, multi-agent systems, foundation models, LLM reasoning, and agentic reinforcement learning.

Academic profile, publications, and projects. English: /en/. 中文: /zh/.

Academic service:
- DAI 2026 Program Committee Co-Chair. DAI 2026 theme: "Agentic AI Goes Live — Science, Systems, and Societies."

## Publications by topic
- [Large language models & reasoning](https://yingwen.io/en/research/llms/): Language model reasoning, search, process reward models, alignment, and evaluation.
- [LLM agents](https://yingwen.io/en/research/llm-agents/): Tool use, multi-turn decision-making, agent memory, protocols, and collaboration.
- [Reinforcement learning](https://yingwen.io/en/research/reinforcement-learning/): Policy optimization, credit assignment, offline learning, decision models, and training systems.
- [Multi-agent games & open-ended learning](https://yingwen.io/en/research/multi-agent/): Multi-agent cooperation and competition, game theory, population diversity, auto-curricula, and zero-shot coordination.
- [Embodied AI & robot learning](https://yingwen.io/en/research/embodied-ai/): Robot manipulation, humanoid interaction, adaptive robot teams, autonomous driving, and embodied evaluation.
- [Machine learning & applications](https://yingwen.io/en/research/machine-learning/): Representation learning, speech synthesis, recommendation, scientific data extraction, and intelligent communications.

## Selected Publications
- [Structured In-context Environment Scaling for Large Language Model Reasoning](https://yingwen.io/en/publications/learning-to-reason-in-structured-in-context-environments-with-reinforcement-lear/): ICLR 2026 2026; tags: LLM reasoning, structured environments, verifiable rewards.
- [Language Games as the Pathway to Artificial Superhuman Intelligence](https://yingwen.io/en/publications/language-games-as-the-pathway-to-artificial-superhuman-intelligence/): arXiv 2025; tags: language games, open-ended learning, artificial superhuman intelligence.
- [Leveraging Dual Process Theory in Language Agent Framework for Real-time Simultaneous Human-AI Collaboration](https://yingwen.io/en/publications/leveraging-dual-process-theory-in-language-agent-framework-for-real-time-simulta/): ACL 2025; tags: human-AI collaboration, dual process theory, real-time agents.
- [ReMA: Learning to Meta-Think for LLMs with Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning](https://yingwen.io/en/publications/rema-neurips-2025/): NeurIPS 2025; tags: meta-thinking, LLM reasoning, multi-agent reinforcement learning.
- [Reinforcing LLM Agents via Policy Optimization with Action Decomposition](https://yingwen.io/en/publications/poad-neurips-2024/): NeurIPS 2024; tags: language agents, action decomposition, credit assignment.
- [AlphaZero-Like Tree-Search can Guide Large Language Model Decoding and Training](https://yingwen.io/en/publications/ts-llm-icml-2024/): ICML 2024; tags: LLM reasoning, tree search, value learning.

## Featured Projects
- [OpenR](https://github.com/openreasoner/openr): Open source framework for advanced reasoning with large language models.

## Recent Research Essays
- From Modern Deep Reinforcement Learning to Continual Reinforcement Learning: Starting from direct interaction in a big world, this essay re-examines the roles of bandits, MDPs, tabular methods, and deep reinforcement learning, then develops how agent state, GVFs, control, models, learning objectives, and meta-learning must co-evolve through continual experience. [English HTML](https://yingwen.io/en/blog/from-modern-deep-rl-to-continual-rl/), [Markdown](https://yingwen.io/en/blog/from-modern-deep-rl-to-continual-rl.md); [中文 HTML](https://yingwen.io/zh/blog/from-modern-deep-rl-to-continual-rl/), [Markdown](https://yingwen.io/zh/blog/from-modern-deep-rl-to-continual-rl.md); [English preprint PDF](https://yingwen.io/preprints/from-modern-deep-rl-to-continual-rl.pdf), [BibTeX](https://yingwen.io/preprints/from-modern-deep-rl-to-continual-rl.bib).
- From Search Scaling to Learning Scaling: A formal distinction between Search Scaling and Learning Scaling, including LLM harness bias–variance, first-person experience, and runtime continual reinforcement learning. [English HTML](https://yingwen.io/en/blog/search-scaling-to-learning-scaling/), [Markdown](https://yingwen.io/en/blog/search-scaling-to-learning-scaling.md); [中文 HTML](https://yingwen.io/zh/blog/search-scaling-to-learning-scaling/), [Markdown](https://yingwen.io/zh/blog/search-scaling-to-learning-scaling.md); [English preprint PDF](https://yingwen.io/preprints/search-scaling-to-learning-scaling.pdf), [BibTeX](https://yingwen.io/preprints/search-scaling-to-learning-scaling.bib).
- What Is a World Model Modeling? From Predicting the Future to Reusing Experience: Why next-generation agents need world models that select controllable, recoverable, and reusable future information rather than only predicting futures. [English HTML](https://yingwen.io/en/blog/what-is-a-world-model-modeling/), [Markdown](https://yingwen.io/en/blog/what-is-a-world-model-modeling.md); [中文 HTML](https://yingwen.io/zh/blog/what-is-a-world-model-modeling/), [Markdown](https://yingwen.io/zh/blog/what-is-a-world-model-modeling.md); [English preprint PDF](https://yingwen.io/preprints/what-is-a-world-model-modeling.pdf), [BibTeX](https://yingwen.io/preprints/what-is-a-world-model-modeling.bib).
- What Environment Do LLM Agents Actually Learn In?: A working definition of large language environments and how LLM agents turn task logs into verifiable, transferable, and reversible experience. [English HTML](https://yingwen.io/en/blog/what-environment-do-llm-agents-learn-in/), [Markdown](https://yingwen.io/en/blog/what-environment-do-llm-agents-learn-in.md); [中文 HTML](https://yingwen.io/zh/blog/what-environment-do-llm-agents-learn-in/), [Markdown](https://yingwen.io/zh/blog/what-environment-do-llm-agents-learn-in.md); [English preprint PDF](https://yingwen.io/preprints/what-environment-do-llm-agents-learn-in.pdf), [BibTeX](https://yingwen.io/preprints/what-environment-do-llm-agents-learn-in.bib).
